text: Connor - 2nd interview @ Deloitte Thurs at 10am, final round, partner + someone from HR. v nervous, barely slept, keeps rewriting his answers to the 'tell me abt a failure' q. his gf Aiko says he's been pacing the flat. he's into running so maybe a quick jog beforehand wd calm him. text him good luck Weds night, then again Thurs morning around 9
Dalia bday 14 Nov. into pottery atm, mentioned a wheel class voucher wd go down well
Mihai called - landed the warehouse mgr job!! starts 2 November 2026. his wife Ann thrilled
coffee w/ Jen & Kerry Sat at 11 @ the usual place
Ricardo - applied for 3 grad schemes, heard nothing back yet. bit low about it tbh
must post Moira's parcel tomorrow morning before 9 - last collection for Scotland
Hassan / Lila - anniversary dinner Fri. 10 yrs! he's booked somewhere in town, keep it quiet from her
Fern's interview went ok she thinks. results by end of next wk. ask her Mon
Chris Novak aka Novo - turning 40 March 2027, big party planned. he collects vinyl, old jazz pressings esp
dentist Tues at 4. pick up dry cleaning after

Caroline - her mum's hip op on the 12th at half 9 @ the General. Caroline driving her in, then staying the wk at hers to help w/ stairs + meals. C's brother Lukas meant to cover the wknd but he's got a work trip to Munich so it's all on her. sounds stretched thin, snapped a bit on the phone. check in w/ C that evening + offer to do the Sat
Lior - housewarming cancelled, landlord delayed keys. now prob early Dec
Lachlan + Eilidh expecting! due April 2027. first one for both. send a card
Lukas - phone interview w/ Siemens went badly, he says. got flustered on the technical q's. call him this wk, see how he's doing
Nina's dog Biscuit had his op yesterday, all fine. she's working from home til Fri to keep an eye on him
Dong - leaving do for his boss Thurs 6pm @ the Crown. I'm doing the collection + card
Stefan's bday Sun. wants new running shoes, Asics, size 10. don't forget to order by Weds

Emily - panel interview for head of year, 2 December 2026 at 2pm. 4 on the panel incl the head. she's prepping a 10 min presentation on pastoral care + attendance. worried abt the data bit, says spreadsheets make her freeze. been at the school 8 yrs so knows everyone, which she thinks makes it worse. offer to go thru it w/ her the wk before, maybe Sun 29th afternoon
Chiara + Laura back from Lisbon Mon. drop round w/ their post
Reggie - got the apprenticeship @ BAE!!! starts Jan. his dad Kwame properly emotional on the phone
Kerry - bday drinks Sat 8pm. she's into gin rn, rhubarb esp
Bilal - redundancy mtg Fri at 3pm. hasn't slept. ring him after, Fri evening

Aiko + Rin moving to Bristol end of Jan. Rin's new job @ the uni there, research post, 3 yr contract. Aiko still looking, applying for design roles - 6 apps out, 1 call back so far from a small agency in Clifton. they've found a flat near the harbour, viewing again 14 Nov. Aiko a bit wobbly abt leaving her mates here
Santiago - visa interview @ embassy tomorrow at 8.30am. send him a quick msg tonight
Xavier - interested in climbing lately, goes to the wall Tues/Thurs. maybe join him one wk
sort car MOT - due 30 Oct. book online
Jen - new job @ NHS from Mon 9 Nov. ask how 1st wk went, Fri 13th
Moira's sister Kerry (not my Kerry) - wedding in Edinburgh 21 Aug 2027. M asked if I'd do a reading. said yes
Connor - Deloitte. didn't get it :( they went w/ internal. he's ok-ish, still has the KPMG one next Tues at 2pm
Dalia + her husband Stefan - their twins turn 5 on Sat. party @ soft play 1-3pm. get the twins something, dinosaur stuff, they're obsessed
Uncle Hassan - 70th coming up, 3 March 2027. family thinking a meal. ask Lila what he'd actually want
called Mihai back re: lift to airport, he can't do Sunday now. ask Chris instead
Ricardo - got an interview!! Lidl regional, Mon 16 Nov at 11. said he'd send me his cv to look over
Fern - turning 30 next mo. said no fuss. likes candles, Diptyque, and anything matcha
ann's leaving drinks Fri moved to the following Fri, 6 Nov, 5:30ish

Lukas - 2nd round @ Siemens after all! Thurs at 3pm, video call w/ the engineering lead. they want a 15 min walkthrough of a past project. still shaky after last time, says his mind went blank on the stress calcs. been practising w/ his flatmate Bilal every night. text him Weds evening, then Thurs after 4 to see how it went
Nina - bday 9 Jan. reads loads of crime fiction, just finished the new Ian Rankin. maybe the next one in the series
pick up prescription, buy milk, ring council abt bin
Caroline - mum home since Sat, recovering ok, a bit sore. C exhausted. take round a lasagne Weds
Chiara - applying for masters in Milan, deadline 15 January 2027. needs a ref from me. write it by xmas
Lila - into wild swimming now, goes Sun mornings @ the lido. wants a changing robe for bday (Feb)

Reggie's grandma passed last wk, peacefully, she was 94. funeral Thurs 11am @ St Mary's, wake after at the cricket club. Kwame asked me to come, he's doing a eulogy and dreading it. Reggie taking it hard, they were close, she basically raised him while K worked nights. must send flowers to the house before, lilies not roses. pop round to Kwame's next wk too
Dong - interview at Ocado tomorrow afternoon, 2:30. his 4th this month, getting fed up. wish him luck in the morning
Eilidh's mum's 60th - surprise party Sat 7 Nov at 7pm. Lachlan sorting the venue, I'm bringing the cake
Laura - got promoted to senior analyst! from Dec 1. was so chuffed. send congrats + maybe a bottle
Bilal - kept on after all, role changed though, new team from Jan. relieved but nervous abt new mgr
call w/ Aiko - she's got a portfolio review Fri at 10 w/ a Bristol agency. her cat Miso hates the move boxes lol. remind her abt my contact Ricardo there
Kwame - big Arsenal fan, season ticket. bday 22 Dec. maybe a framed shirt? ask Reggie his size
Emily - interview moved to Thurs 3 Dec, same time. she's relieved, more prep time
Santiago's visa approved! flying to Toronto 2 Feb 2027 for the new role. leaving do tbc, prob late Jan. need to organise smth w/ Xavier
weekend: Sat am gym, Sat pm Dalia's twins' party, Sun lunch @ mum's at 1. no time for anything else
Moira - Mrs Gupta from her work retiring 18 Dec, M's organising a gift. chip in £10

Stefan - new job offer from Wang & Khan Solicitors, deciding by Fri at 5pm. torn. more money (abt 8k) but longer commute + they want him in 4 days a wk. current place letting him go part time from March for his law conversion course which he'd lose. his wife Dalia wants him to take it. meet him for a pint Thurs to talk it thru
Xavier - 1st climbing comp next Sat, bouldering. v nervous. go watch if I can, starts 10am
Chris aka Novo - drove past his old flat, reminded me, haven't heard from him since the summer. drop him a text
Lior's new date for housewarming: Sat 5 December 2026 at 7. bring wine, he's vegetarian now so no meat stuff

Hassan + Lila - dinner was lovely apparently, she cried when he did a speech abt their first date at the Turkish place on Green St. he wants to do Rome for their 11th next year, Oct 2027. she's mad abt Italian food + old churches. said I'd send him the name of that hotel near Trastevere we stayed at
Kerry - started at the bakery on Mon, early shifts 5am. loves it but knackered. her bf Lachlan moaning abt the alarms
Rin - first day at uni of Bristol 4 Jan at 9am. ask how it went that evening. Aiko got the agency job btw!! starts Feb

Jen - 1st wk @ NHS done, says team lovely but IT a nightmare. her daughter Emily starts nursery next mo, Jen anxious abt the drop offs. Jen's bday 30 Nov too - into houseplants, wants a big monstera. maybe go halves w/ Kerry, sort by the 25th
